test_cases.name: Export Markdown report (default current-dir output)
test_cases.expected: Prints the generated .md path; file has title, header row (实例名称/实例ID/状态/引擎/版本/规格/私网IP/可用区/创建时间) + one row per instance

test_cases.name: Explicit output path
test_cases.expected: Markdown file written to the given path

test_cases.name: Name / status filters
test_cases.expected: Only matching instances rendered (status applied client-side)

test_cases.name: Empty result still writes a Markdown file
test_cases.expected: Header + '无 RDS 实例' note written, exit 0, no error

notes: 只读操作（ListInstances），无资源创建/修改/删除风险；Markdown 仅在本机生成，绝不写回云端。CLI 主路径使用 hcloud RDS ListInstances（只读 GET /v3/{project_id}/instances）；SDK 回退使用 huaweicloudsdkrds v3；SDK 依赖缺失时可运行 scripts/ensure_env.py 自动安装。缺 hcloud 后端/凭据时用例按后端可用性降级或跳过，不产生伪失败；真实只读验证由 QA 带外执行。
